author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Displays privacy-gated, self-requested viewer cards from bounded Viewer Foundation and Community Analytics projections.
changelog: 2.4.3: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.4.3 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.2: initial disabled-by-default Spotlight mode with self-only command requests, authenticated creator-only manual display, style-aware fake preview, disclosure gate, cooldowns, bounded ephemeral queue, projection revalidation, and customizable hosted cards.

manifest.name: Viewer Spotlight
installationSteps: Install and enable Viewer Foundation and Community Analytics first.
Install Viewer Spotlight, review public fields, accept the disclosure, and enable it.
Create the card command through Command Sync with no generated response.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall the add-on. Its pseudonymous cooldown state remains preserved for a later reinstall.

healthChecks.description: Confirms bounded self-request handling and projection-only overlay publication.
